title: Parameter record (workforce)
description: Format for one calibrated workforce parameter in the private registry. This file is the public interface: anyone can build a tool that reads or writes this format. Parameter values themselves are held in the private registry and are not published in this repository. Handling: Unclassified — working.

parameter_id.description: Immutable id. Class codes: DEC decay, TER simulator transfer, THR proficiency threshold, TTC time to competency, CUR re-currency, INS instructor ratio, LAB labour market, CRT certification, CST cost.

entity_type.description: Which public table the parameter attaches to.

entity_id.description: Foreign key to the public record (e.g. SK-07).

value.description: Point estimate. Must be null when uncited is true: an uncited parameter carries a range, never a point value.

unit.description: Explicit unit, e.g. SD/month, ratio, months, percent, CAD.

uncited.description: True when no source supports the value. Uncited parameters stay visible; they are never dropped.

extrapolated_from.description: Domain the evidence comes from when it is not the target domain (e.g. aviation, military, medicine). Null only if the evidence is on the target population.

independence_group.description: Sources sharing authors, data or principals share a group. Two sources in one group count as one for corroboration.

reviewer_role.description: Role id, never a personal name.

sensitivity_note.description: Result of the plus/minus 50% sweep: which decisions flip.
